description: Speculative verify steps of one request (DSpark block 7: 8 rows; DFLASH with 6 draft tokens: 6 rows) on one Kimi-K3.1 MLA (DSA) layer at TP8 that is not a block-write layer: rows = the verify tokens, nblocks = the AttnRes bank rows the layer reads (layer // 12 + 1: 1 on layers 4 and 8 up to 8 on layers 88 and 92). The kernel has no context dependence and the model fixes every non-batch dimension, so the performance cases cover the production range under the production-range span exemption (workload_evidence.json). Derived from the serving configuration, the model's layer structure and the AgentX corpus statistics; not yet confirmed by a live capture. Rows 1 and 3 (compiled widths no documented verify configuration uses) are correctness-only.
